name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Rc Switch Raw
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sends a raw RC-Switch code to a remote transmitter.

config_entries.label: Code
config_entries.description: The raw code to send, copy this from the dump output.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Protocol
config_entries.description: The RC Switch protocol to use, see [RC Switch Protocol](https://esphome.io/components/remote_transmitter/#rc-switch-protocol) for more information.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.

config_entries.label: Times
config_entries.description: The number of times to repeat the code.

config_entries.label: Wait Time
config_entries.description: The time to wait between repeats (in µs as a result of a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)).
